list.title: Autonomous agents
list.subtitle: Agents watch the feedback in their scope and, when a trigger fires, run a workflow: research, personas, PR/FAQ, PRD and a prototype, reviewed by personas before handing off a project.
list.createHint: It is created disabled with its own editable copy of the “Reviews → Prototype” workflow. Configure triggers and the workflow, then enable it.
list.emptyAdmin: Create one to turn new feedback into researched projects and prototypes automatically.
list.emptyUser: An administrator hasn't set up any agent you can see yet.

list.spendHint: Manual runs are not counted against the daily scheduled-run limit.

library.title: Workflow library
library.subtitle: Every workflow agents can run. Archive the ones you no longer need: they leave the library and become read-only, and their revisions are kept.

library.renameConflict: Someone changed this workflow meanwhile, or it is the built-in one. Reload and try again.
library.createEngineeringHint: An engineering flow runs autonomous engineering agents on a repository and ends on a pull request for people to review. It starts as Start → End: add the Engineering steps from the palette.
library.templatesHint: Six default engineering flows to start from. Choosing one opens a copy in the editor: nothing is saved until you save it.

fields.instructionsHint: Guidance the agent follows in every step (up to {{n, number}} characters).
fields.visibility: Visibility of the projects it hands off
fields.visibilityHint: Private projects are visible to their owner, members and administrators only.
fields.workflowHint: Edit the steps on the Workflow tab.

roleHint.persona: Speaks for each persona in reviews.

budget.runsPerDayHint: At most 2. Manual runs are not counted.
budget.monthlyCapHint: The agent stops starting runs once the month's calls reach this cap.

run.hint: Each run follows the workflow. The graph lights up the steps as they run; it is a view, not a control.
run.alreadyRunning: A run is already in progress.
run.confirmMessage: The agent runs its workflow now. It calls the AI models (up to {{calls, number}} calls) and can take several minutes. You can cancel it from this tab.

methodology.title: Methodology
methodology.hint: Advice only: the workflow still saves and runs. The methodology goes evidence → personas → PR/FAQ → PRD → prototype.

methodology.noPrfaq: no PR/FAQ step before it: the methodology writes the PR/FAQ first.
methodology.noDocument: no PR/FAQ or PRD step before it.

workflowPage.title: Workflow
workflowPage.subtitle: A workflow from the library. Agents that run it use its newest saved revision.

startRun.title: Start a run of {{name}}
startRun.description: The run starts this flow as last saved, on one commit of a connected repository. It reaches the repository only once the connection’s credential is stored.

startRun.noBudget: The flow has no monthly budget.
startRun.mayHaveStarted: The run may have been started: check the runs list before you start another.
startRun.saveFirst: Save the flow first: a run uses the saved version.

loopUntilHint.persona_agreement: Repeats while the persona review in the loop answers "Not agreed".
loopUntilHint.review_pass: Repeats while a review step in the loop answers "Fail".

aggregate_reviews.label: Aggregate reviews
aggregate_reviews.description: Collects the new feedback in the agent's scope and finds the main themes.

select_or_create_project.label: Select or create project
select_or_create_project.description: Reuses a project with the same purpose, or creates a new one.

select_personas.label: Select personas
select_personas.description: Picks the personas that matter for these reviews.

generate_personas.label: Generate personas
generate_personas.description: Creates new personas from the feedback when none fit.

deep_research.label: Deep research
deep_research.description: Runs a research job on the project, optionally with web search.

write_prfaq.label: Write PR/FAQ
write_prfaq.description: Drafts a press release and FAQ for the idea.

revise_document.label: Revise document
revise_document.description: Rewrites a document from the review's objections.

duplicate_document.label: Duplicate document
duplicate_document.description: Copies a document into another project.

persona_review.label: Persona review
persona_review.description: Personas score the work; agreement = average 4+ and nothing blocking.

final_review.label: Final review
final_review.description: A reviewer checks the whole package before hand-off.

custom_llm.label: Custom step
custom_llm.description: A step driven by your own instructions.

build_prototype.label: Build prototype
build_prototype.description: Builds an HTML prototype using the design system.

collect_prototype_feedback.label: Collect tester pins
collect_prototype_feedback.description: Reads the open pins testers dropped on the prototype, for the next revision.

revise_prototype.label: Revise prototype
revise_prototype.description: Changes the prototype from the review's objections.

handoff.label: Hand off
handoff.description: Gives the project to the owner of its main category.

agent.label: Agent
agent.description: An agent with a role (fixer, hunter, committer…), its skill version and its share of the budget.

map.label: Map
map.description: Split the work into shards (packages, history windows, PR pages) that agents take in parallel.

reduce.label: Reduce
reduce.description: Where a map's shards meet again: one result from all of them.

board.label: Board
board.description: A task board: some roles post tasks, others claim and do them, until it is drained.

quality_gate.label: Quality gate
quality_gate.description: Checks and review rounds on the change: GO goes on to the PR, NO-GO to a person.

learning_loop.label: Learning loop
learning_loop.description: A retrospective that writes what the run learned to memory.

self_improvement.label: Self-improvement
self_improvement.description: The coach proposes a better skill version and benchmarks it.

memory.label: Memory
memory.description: Read from or write to the repository's, a role's or a person's memory.

stop_at_pr.label: Stop at PR
stop_at_pr.description: The flow ends on a pull request for people to review: nothing is ever merged.

plans.title: Plans
plans.subtitle: Multi-step requests you approved in the AI assistant. They run in the background; open one to follow its steps, approve a step that asks, or cancel it.
plans.empty: No plans yet. Ask the AI assistant for something with several steps, and approve the plan it proposes.
plans.removeMessage: “{{goal}}” will be removed from your plans. Its results stay in your projects.
plans.removeFailed: The plan couldn’t be deleted. A plan that is still running must be cancelled first.

validation.instructions: The instructions can be up to {{max, number}} characters.

validation.personas: Choose at most {{max, number}} fixed personas.
validation.models: Choose an available model for each role, or the default.
validation.budget: Check the budget: the limits must be whole numbers in range.
validation.other: Some settings are not valid. Check them and try again.

decided.stop: {{by}} chose to close the run at {{at}}.

form.question: What should happen next?
form.pickObjections: Objections to fix (a blocking persona’s are ticked)
form.instructionsPlaceholder: For example: commit to paying hotels and meals when the wait is over 12 hours.

fix.label: Revise once more, fixing the objections I pick
fix.help: The document is revised with your picks and notes, then the personas review it again. If they still disagree, the run asks you again.
fix.incomplete: Pick at least one objection or write an instruction.

accept.label: Accept it as it is and continue
accept.help: The workflow carries on after “{{node}}” as if the personas had agreed. Their objections are not fixed.

other.label: Something else: tell the agent what to do
other.help: Your instructions go to the next revision, then the personas review it again.
other.incomplete: Write what the agent should do.

stop.label: Close the run
stop.help: Nothing more runs. What the run produced stays in the project.

spend.hint: What the engineering agents spent, from the spend ledger: each session’s cost, tokens and MicroVM time, as the runtime measured them. The cost is MicroVM time so far: model tokens are counted, not yet priced. Months are in UTC.
spend.budgetHint: Each workflow’s monthly budget as it is now, and the share of it spent this month (MicroVM time only, for now).
spend.hardCap: Hard cap at each workflow’s monthly budget
spend.hardCapHint: Off by default. On: a run started from a workflow with a budget gets a cost cap of what is left of the workflow’s month, and does not start when nothing is left. Each run’s cap is set when it starts, so runs of one workflow at the same time may together pass its budget (MicroVM time only, for now). Session time is priced at the deployment’s AgentCore rates; model tokens are counted, not yet priced.

connections.title: Repository connections
connections.intro: The engineering agents reach a repository through a connection: the repository, its default branch and a credential stored for them. A stored credential is never shown again, to anyone.
connections.limitReached: This deployment holds at most {{limit, number}} connections. Remove one to add another.
connections.loadFailed: The repository connections could not be loaded.
connections.emptyHint: Add one so the engineering agents can work on a repository.
connections.notSetHint: The stored credential is missing: edit the connection and save it with its credential again.

guidance.title: What the credential needs
guidance.app: Create a GitHub App and install it only on this repository. Repository permissions: Contents, Pull requests and Issues set to Read and write, Metadata to Read-only. Nothing else: no Administration, Workflows, Secrets, Actions or organization permission.
guidance.token: The App is never handed to the agents: for each step the broker mints a token valid for one hour, for this one repository and only what the step needs of the App's permissions (Contents, Pull requests and Issues, read and write; Metadata, read-only; never admin).
guidance.branch: Protect the default branch, and let the agents push only to branches named voc-agent/*.

dialog.description: The engineering agents use this connection to read the repository and propose changes to it.
dialog.keepHint: The stored credential is never shown. Leave the private key empty to keep it; a new repository, App id or installation id needs the private key again.

hints.connectionId: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, up to 63. It cannot change once the connection is added.
hints.connectionIdFixed: Chosen when the connection was added; it cannot change.
hints.repository: owner/name, as in the repository’s address.
hints.defaultBranch: The branch the agents start from and propose their changes to.
hints.installationId: The numeric id of the App’s installation on this repository.
hints.privateKey: The App’s private key: the whole .pem file GitHub generated, up to about 4 KB. It is sent once and never shown again.

invalid.connectionId: Enter an id of 1 to 63 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter or a digit.
invalid.defaultBranch: Enter a branch name: letters, digits, “.”, “_”, “-” and “/”, at most {{max, number}} characters, no “..”, not a voc-agent/ branch.
invalid.appId: Enter the App id: digits only.
invalid.installationId: Enter the installation id: digits only.
invalid.privateKeyEmpty: Paste the App’s private key: a new connection needs its credential.
invalid.privateKeyNeeded: Paste the App’s private key again: a new repository, App id or installation id is stored with it.
invalid.privateKey: Paste the whole unencrypted RSA key in PEM, from its BEGIN line to its END line.
invalid.privateKeyLarge: The key is larger than a credential holds (about 4 KB): use the App’s own private key.

confirm.title: Remove {{repository}}?
confirm.message: This removes the connection and its stored credential. Runs working on {{repository}} lose access within five minutes: their reads and writes fail until a connection is stored again.

errors.notFound: The connection was not found, or the engineering agents are off.
errors.conflict: The connection cannot change now: stop its live runs first, or remove another connection.
errors.unavailable: The connections are unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.generic: The connection could not be changed. Try again.

templatePage.notFound: This template isn't available here: templates are offered only where the engineering agents module is deployed.
templatePage.adminOnly: Only administrators start engineering flows from a template. Ask an administrator, or go back to the workflow library.

understandRepository.name: Understand the repository
understandRepository.description: Maps the repository package by package and drafts its knowledge pack, tenets and review guide for an administrator's approval.

issueTriage.name: Issue triage
issueTriage.description: Reads an issue, classifies it as a bug, a feature or an investigation, reproduces or locates it and proposes the next step on the issue.

bugHunt.name: Bug hunt and fix
bugHunt.description: Hunts bugs in the packages it is given, fixes and reviews each one, runs the quality gate and stops at a draft pull request.

feature.name: Feature from an issue or a PRD
feature.description: Builds a feature from an issue or a PRD: understands it, plans, builds, commits and reviews, runs the quality gate and stops at a draft pull request.

prReview.name: PR review
prReview.description: Reviews a pull request in one pass, its pages in parallel, against the repository's tenets and review guide, and leaves review comments.

selfImprovement.name: Self-improvement
selfImprovement.description: The coach reads past runs, proposes new skill versions and benchmarks them; an administrator accepts or declines each one.
